headline: Stagflation and Systemic Stress cut the 60/40’s implied risk-adjusted return by about 40%
takeaway: Why: in both, Gradient’s overlays cut expected equity returns and raise equity volatility. Stagflation also lowers bonds’ implied return (to 1.41%) and is assumed to last 3 years; Systemic Stress assumes bonds rally (2.41%) but lasts 2. At equal assumed duration Systemic Stress would be harsher (0.25 vs 0.29), so neither is clearly the worst.
